title: aegilops tauschii f. ferruginea
intro: Aegilops tauschii f. ferruginea, commonly known as Dinkel wheat, is a subspecies of the wild wheat Aegilops tauschii, belonging to the family Poaceae. Dinkel wheat is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help lower cholesterol levels, regulate blood sugar, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Dinkel wheat include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the prevention of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of Dinkel wheat include avenanthramides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
